title: DCGAN Throughput Benchmark: 256x256 RGB (B=16, W=64)
intuition: Primary high-resolution 256x256 RGB DCGAN compute, VRAM, and NVML energy benchmark (Law 2 anchor): exposes the 3.6x latency / 66% energy crossover between 1-probe `fwAD` and reverse-over-reverse gradient penalties.
failure_mode: Reverse-over-reverse double backprop (`create_graph=True`), ambient O(BKD) pixel-space prior ops, or dense matrix decompositions severely inflate ms/step, peak MiB, and Joules/step.
protocol_notes: Four Laws Adherence Law 2 throughput anchor; mock Uniform[-1,1] RGB data only (no image-quality or qualification credit).
